post.title: When your W-2, 1099s and tax refund actually arrive
post.ig:
Your employer doesn't have to send your W-2 until Feb. 1, 2027.
Jan. 31, 2027 is a Sunday, so W-2s and most 1099s are due Monday, Feb. 1. Brokerage 1099-Bs are due Feb. 16 (Feb. 15 is Presidents' Day).
The IRS usually opens filing season in late January; the 2026 season opened Jan. 26, 2026.
IRS: most e-filed refunds with direct deposit arrive within 21 days. By law, refunds claiming the EITC or ACTC are held until mid-February; in 2026 the IRS expected most by March 2.
Average refund, IRS weekly report covering Tax Day week: $3,012 (2022), $2,753 (2023), $2,850 (2024), $2,942 (2025), $3,275 (2026).
Sources: IRS filing season statistics (weeks ending Apr. 22, 2022; Apr. 21, 2023; Apr. 19, 2024; Apr. 18, 2025; Apr. 17, 2026), IRS IR-2026-02 and IR-2026-12, IRS PATH Act guidance.
